name: feature.insights-suite.agents
description: Insights & Drafting Agent Suite agent pack — three role-scoped manifest agents driven through the existing chat: Financial (Actual-vs-Plan variance analysis), Communication (in-voice recognition drafting, never auto-send), Talent (9-box readiness). Each is tool-allowlisted to the suite's pure compute nodes + KB retrieval (the read-only connector queries ride the workflow-run/executor path, not conversational tools); none can write or send. 1.1.0 (ADR 0600 §8 / ISC-12): the Financial agent's description and prompt no longer promise SQL provenance or scheduled-run figures the pipeline cannot hand it.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Financial Analyst
agents.description: Computes Actual-vs-Plan variance for sales/margin/labor/shrink from figures the human supplies, and surfaces off-plan hot spots. Returns NO provenance (no SQL, no as-of timestamp) — it says so rather than implying a verification path that does not exist. Never writes; flags figures for human review.

agents.label: Communication Drafter
agents.description: Drafts authentic, in-voice recognition messages (work anniversaries, milestones) by retrieving the principal's past messages as style exemplars. ALWAYS a draft for approval — never sends. Humble, gratitude-led tone; bans corporate buzzwords.

agents.label: Talent Advisor
agents.description: Reads talent/development data read-only, computes 9-box performance×potential readiness, and prepares talent-review insight for direct reports and two levels down. Read-only HRIS; never writes.
